attributes.name: Physique
attributes.description: Bodily size, strength and stamina; how well you endure hardship and deal or take punishment.

attributes.name: Precision
attributes.description: Coordination, steady hands and fine motor control.

attributes.name: Logic
attributes.description: Reasoning, education and problem-solving; can also be used to face frightening situations.

attributes.name: Empathy
attributes.description: Understanding, charming, persuading or deceiving others; can also be used to face frightening situations.

skills.name: Agility
skills.description: Running, climbing, jumping, fleeing and dodging; successes can be shared with others doing the same action.

skills.name: Close Combat
skills.description: Fighting with melee weapons; extra successes add damage, swap initiative, inflict mental Conditions, shove or disarm.

skills.name: Force
skills.description: Raw strength, enduring pain and privation, crude repairs, wrestling and unarmed fighting; extra successes can grapple or add damage.

skills.name: Medicine
skills.description: Treating the hurt; a daily test heals three physical Conditions (three more per extra success) or saves a Broken character.

skills.name: Ranged Combat
skills.description: Attacking with firearms, thrown weapons and explosives; extra successes add damage, swap initiative, stress, shove or disarm.

skills.name: Stealth
skills.description: Sneaking, hiding, picking locks and sleight of hand.

skills.name: Investigation
skills.description: Searching places, reading crime scenes and examining bodies to receive clues from the Gamemaster.

skills.name: Learning
skills.description: Education and reasoning: recalling facts, translating languages, understanding devices, rituals or basic vaesen lore.

skills.name: Vigilance
skills.description: Noticing threats, tracking and reading a watched situation; each extra success gives +1 to a related later test.

skills.name: Inspiration
skills.description: Swaying crowds, encouraging friends and art; a daily test heals three mental Conditions (three more per extra success).

skills.name: Manipulation
skills.description: Lying, flirting, bribing, haggling and persuading individuals; extra successes in opposed tests inflict mental Conditions.

skills.name: Observation
skills.description: Reading what someone thinks, feels or intends; each extra success gives +1 to a test where that knowledge helps.

archetypes.name: Academic
archetypes.summary: A scholar who trusts books and reason to explain what others call superstition.
motivations: Writing the treatise that finally classifies the unseen
Restoring a reputation lost to a scholarly scandal
Deciphering a manuscript left by a vanished mentor
traumas: Read aloud a passage that made the library walls bleed
Spent a winter night lost in a fog that whispered equations
Found a colleague turned to bark and moss in the archive
darkSecrets: Bought rare texts from grave robbers
Signed a pact in ink you cannot remember mixing
Your doctoral thesis was written by someone else
relationships: You are a fascinating subject of study
I owe you for defending me before the faculty
You talk too much and think too little

archetypes.name: Doctor
archetypes.summary: A physician who has seen wounds no textbook can explain and swore to heal them anyway.
motivations: Finding a cure for the sleeping sickness in my home parish
Proving the unseen leave marks on the flesh
Atoning for a patient I let die
traumas: Delivered a child that was not human
Watched a cholera ward empty in a single night of singing
Amputated a limb that kept moving afterwards
darkSecrets: Dependent on laudanum
Paid body snatchers for cadavers
Practised without a valid licence
relationships: You remind me of a patient I could not save
I keep a careful eye on your health
You never follow my advice

archetypes.name: Hunter
archetypes.summary: A tracker of the deep forest who knows that some prey hunts back.
motivations: Bringing down the beast that took my brother
Keeping the old forest paths safe for the villages
Earning a bounty large enough to buy my own land
traumas: Followed tracks that turned into human footprints
Shot something that wept like a child
Was dragged into a bog and left there for a night
darkSecrets: Poached on a nobleman's estate for years
Killed a man and blamed it on a wolf
Feed something in the woods so it spares your cabin
relationships: You would not last a night in the forest
I trust you to watch my back
You scare the game away

archetypes.name: Occultist
archetypes.summary: A seeker of hidden arts who senses that their own nature is not wholly human.
motivations: Mastering a power I only half understand
Finding the coven that cast me out
Opening a door between worlds, carefully
traumas: Saw your own face on a corpse in a dream that came true
A spirit refused to leave after a seance
Burned your hands on a sigil that drew itself
darkSecrets: You were left by the trolls in another child's cradle
You sold a fake seance that drove a widow mad
Something speaks through you when you sleep
relationships: I have seen your death in the cards
You are the only one who does not fear me
You mock what you do not understand

archetypes.name: Officer
archetypes.summary: A soldier of rank who came home from war with honor and nightmares in equal measure.
motivations: Upholding the oath I gave the Crown
Protecting the men who still follow me
Finding a war worth fighting
traumas: Led a patrol into a mist from which only you returned
Saw fallen soldiers rise and march home
Was buried alive under a collapsed redoubt
darkSecrets: Deserted your post during a battle
Ordered the burning of an innocent village
Owe gambling debts to a dangerous man
relationships: You need discipline
You saved my life once and I never thanked you
I would follow you into any battle

archetypes.name: Priest
archetypes.summary: A servant of the Church who has learned that the old devils are real.
motivations: Bringing the light of God to the darkest parishes
Proving faith is stronger than fear
Earning forgiveness for my former doubts
traumas: Heard the church bells ring at midnight with no ringer
Performed an exorcism that failed
Buried a whole family who died the same night
darkSecrets: You no longer truly believe
Fathered a child in secret
Keep a confession you should have taken to the authorities
relationships: I pray for your soul every night
You confide in me more than you should
Your sins are written on your face

archetypes.name: Private Detective
archetypes.summary: An investigator for hire who follows clues wherever they lead, even into the unseen.
motivations: Solving the case the police buried
Clearing my father's name
Earning enough to leave the city for good
traumas: Found a murder victim who answered your questions
Was locked in a cellar with something that breathed
Followed a suspect into a house that was not there the next day
darkSecrets: Planted evidence to close a case
Blackmail a prominent family
Once worked for a criminal syndicate
relationships: I suspect you are hiding something
You are my best informant
We work well together, as long as you do as I say

archetypes.name: Servant
archetypes.summary: A hardworking domestic who knows the secrets of the great houses and how to survive them.
motivations: Keeping the household I serve safe
Saving enough to buy a farm of my own
Learning what really happened to the previous maid
traumas: Cleaned a room where the blood kept returning
Heard your master's voice from an empty bed
Was trapped in the cold larder by something with long fingers
darkSecrets: Stole silver from your employers
Know who poisoned the old count and said nothing
Were born out of wedlock to a noble
relationships: I will take care of you whether you like it or not
You treat me as an equal and I am grateful
You expect me to clean up after you

archetypes.name: Vagabond
archetypes.summary: A rootless wanderer of the roads who knows the signs, the people and the dangers of every parish.
motivations: Finding a place where I belong
Warning the road folk of the dangers I have seen
Staying one step ahead of my past
traumas: Slept in a barn and woke up in a stranger's grave
Was chased for three nights by lights on the moor
Saw a fellow traveler taken beneath a bridge
darkSecrets: Wanted for a crime in another county
Robbed a dying man on the road
Made a bargain with the troll under the mountain
relationships: You are too soft for this life
I would share my last crust with you
You look down on my kind

archetypes.name: Writer
archetypes.summary: A poet or journalist driven to capture the unseen world in words, whatever the price.
motivations: Writing the story that will make my name
Exposing the truth the newspapers will not print
Recapturing the voice that once wrote through me
traumas: Your words came true exactly as written
Saw your own obituary in tomorrow's paper
A reader's letter arrived written in your own blood
darkSecrets: Your best work was plagiarized
You wrote slander that ruined an innocent man
Your muse is a vaesen who demands payment
relationships: You will be a character in my next book
I admire you more than I let on
You are hiding a story I must uncover

talents.name: Bookworm
talents.effect: +2 to Learning when searching for clues in books or libraries.

talents.name: Erudite
talents.effect: A successful Learning test lets you declare facts about places and phenomena, subject to GM approval; not about vaesen.

talents.name: Knowledge is Reassuring
talents.effect: Conditions give no penalty to your Learning tests.

talents.name: Army Medic
talents.effect: +2 to Fear tests caused by dead or mutilated human bodies.

talents.name: Chief Physician
talents.effect: Your Medicine treatment of player characters heals four Conditions instead of three, including per extra success.

talents.name: Emergency Medicine
talents.effect: Mental Conditions give no penalty to your Medicine tests.

talents.name: Bloodhound
talents.effect: +2 to Vigilance when tracking prey.

talents.name: Herbalist
talents.effect: You can use Medicine with wild herbs instead of medical supplies.

talents.name: Marksman
talents.effect: +2 to Ranged Combat in your first turn after a successful ambush or attack.

talents.name: Conjuring Tricks
talents.effect: Use Stealth in place of Manipulation when influencing people with conjuring tricks.

talents.name: Medium
talents.effect: Use Observation to hold seances that foretell futures or reach the dead; extra successes give more, failure brings false information, attack or a Condition.

talents.name: Strike Fear
talents.effect: Slow action: one NPC in your zone faces Fear 1 (Logic or Empathy, +1 die per ally present); useless against vaesen.

talents.name: Battle-hardened
talents.effect: Draw two initiative cards and keep the one you prefer.

talents.name: Gentleman
talents.effect: Mental Conditions give no penalty to your Manipulation tests.

talents.name: Tactician
talents.effect: Spend an extra Ranged Combat success in combat to order an ally; obeying gives them +2 on their next test; repeatable for different allies.

talents.name: Absolution
talents.effect: Player characters confessing to you as an activity heal three Conditions rather than two.

talents.name: Blessing
talents.effect: Once per session bless a character or object, granting a Blessed Advantage of +2 on one test; same target once per mystery.

talents.name: Confessor
talents.effect: Use Observation in place of Manipulation during confidential conversations.

talents.name: Eagle Eye
talents.effect: +2 to Vigilance when interpreting a situation you are not part of.

talents.name: Elementary
talents.effect: Once per session the GM explains how the clues you hold fit together.

talents.name: Focused
talents.effect: Conditions give no penalty to your Investigation tests.

talents.name: Loyal
talents.effect: +2 to Fear tests while near someone you have sworn to protect.

talents.name: Robust
talents.effect: Once per session ignore physical Condition penalties on a single roll.

talents.name: Tough as Nails
talents.effect: +2 to Force when fighting unarmed.

talents.name: Hobo Tricks
talents.effect: +2 to Stealth when hiding yourself or an item from a wealthy person.

talents.name: Suspicious
talents.effect: Mental Conditions give no penalty to your Vigilance tests.

talents.name: Well-traveled
talents.effect: Once per mystery a Manipulation test creates a local NPC you once knew; on failure they are hostile or desperate for help.

talents.name: Automatic Writing
talents.effect: Once per session channel spirits with Inspiration for clues; failure may bring a Condition, possession or a 1D6-hour personality shift.

talents.name: Journalist
talents.effect: Use Inspiration in place of Manipulation when charming or tricking someone for information.

talents.name: Wordsmith
talents.effect: Conditions give no penalty to your Inspiration tests.

talents.name: Battle Experience
talents.effect: +2 to Medicine when treating a physical critical injury.

talents.name: Brave
talents.effect: +1 to every Fear test.

talents.name: Combat-trained
talents.effect: +2 to Close Combat and Force when parrying.

talents.name: Contacts
talents.effect: Once per session declare you already know a friendly NPC, unless the GM vetoes it.

talents.name: Coward
talents.effect: Once per combat, when hit, a free Stealth test shifts the damage to another PC; failure adds 1 damage to you.

talents.name: Deceptive
talents.effect: +2 to Manipulation when cheating or deceiving.

talents.name: Dedicated
talents.effect: Once per session ignore mental Condition penalties on one skill test.

talents.name: Defensive
talents.effect: One extra action each turn, usable only to dodge or parry.

talents.name: Dual Weapons
talents.effect: Fighting with two melee weapons, spend extra successes to hit another enemy in the zone and split bonus damage as you choose.

talents.name: Dynamiter
talents.effect: +2 to Ranged Combat with explosives.

talents.name: Empathetic
talents.effect: Conditions give no penalty to your Observation tests.

talents.name: Escape Artist
talents.effect: Conditions give no penalty when using Agility to flee.

talents.name: Famous
talents.effect: +2 to Manipulation against someone who knows of you.

talents.name: Fleet-footed
talents.effect: Move within your own zone in combat without spending an action.

talents.name: Holy Symbol
talents.effect: A religious item lets you attack vaesen in close combat with Inspiration, dealing 1 damage.

talents.name: Lightning Reflexes
talents.effect: Drawing a weapon costs no action.

talents.name: Nine Lives
talents.effect: On critical injury rolls you choose which die is tens and which is ones.

talents.name: Pet
talents.effect: Once per session your pet gives +1 to a test where it plausibly helps.

talents.name: Pugilist
talents.effect: +1 damage when fighting unarmed.

talents.name: Safety in Numbers
talents.effect: +2 to Fear tests with at least two other PCs present (same zone in combat).

talents.name: Sixth Sense
talents.effect: Extra Investigation successes reveal whether a vaesen was here, hints of its kind, and whether magic was used.

talents.name: Sprinter
talents.effect: +2 to Agility when chasing or outrunning someone.

talents.name: The Lord's Shepherd
talents.effect: +2 to Inspiration when treating a mental critical injury.

talents.name: Wealthy
talents.effect: Resources +1; may be taken several times.

notes: Each physical Condition is -1 die to Physique and Precision skills; each mental Condition is -1 die to Logic and Empathy skills and Fear tests.
Taking a fourth Condition of a type when all three are marked makes you Broken: no actions of either kind and a critical injury roll.

resourceNotes: Start at the archetype's minimum; before play each skill point spent raises Resources by one, up to the archetype's maximum.

mementos.item: Signet ring with a hidden compartment
Strange animal in a glass jar
Small perfume bottle with a familiar scent
Pocket watch with a portrait inside
Sheet music by a forgotten composer
Lucky charm, such as a rabbit's foot

dice.pushing: After failing a test you may push once, immediately: reroll every die that is not a six and suffer a Condition (physical for Physique/Precision, mental for Logic/Empathy). The Condition takes effect after the reroll, so pushing can leave you Broken.
dice.fear: Roll Logic or Empathy plus 1 die per other able PC present (max +3); successes needed equal the Fear value (1-3); failure means Terrified for 1D6 rounds and mental Conditions equal to Fear value, minus 1 per success.
notes: Dice pool is attribute plus skill; a skill of 0 rolls the attribute alone.
One six is usually enough; challenging actions need 2 sixes, difficult ones need 3.
Each Condition of the matching type removes one die; you always roll at least one die.
An Advantage adds +2 dice once per session and must be declared before rolling or when pushing.
Equipment usually gives +1, rarely up to +3; each helper gives +1, maximum +3.
All modifiers are summed; a push cannot be pushed again.
Extra sixes beyond those required can buy skill-specific effects, one success each.
Opposed rolls: most successes wins; ties mean neither side succeeds outright.
